core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix tactical military aesthetics with high-end fitness luxury.
Emotion First: Every pixel must scream 'Motivation' and 'Discipline'.
Content is King: The story of transformation drives the layout.
Zoom In: Focus on sweat, metal, and texture.
Negative Space: Use deep black voids to make the red accents pop.
anti_patterns: No center-aligned text blocks (unless for specific dramatic effect).

usage_rules.h1: text-6xl md:text-8xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase font-headings
usage_rules.h2: text-4xl md:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight uppercase font-headings
usage_rules.h3: text-2xl md:text-3xl font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase font-headings text-red-500
usage_rules.body: text-base md:text-lg font-normal leading-relaxed text-gray-300 font-body

marketing_page.grid_system: Mode A: The Tetris Grid (Asymmetrical, Artful)

dashboard.grid_system: Mode B: High Density Grid (Dense, Functional)
dashboard.style: Tactical Command Center - Sharp edges, high contrast borders

buttons.primary: rounded-none uppercase tracking-widest font-bold px-8 py-4 bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white transition-all duration-300 skew-x-[-10deg]
buttons.secondary: rounded-none uppercase tracking-widest font-bold px-8 py-4 border border-white/20 hover:bg-white/10 text-white transition-all duration-300 skew-x-[-10deg]
buttons.ghost: rounded-none uppercase tracking-widest font-bold px-6 py-3 text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition-colors

cards.marketing: bg-zinc-900/50 border border-white/5 hover:border-red-500/50 transition-colors duration-300 p-8 backdrop-blur-sm

inputs.style: bg-zinc-950 border-zinc-800 focus:border-red-500 focus:ring-red-500/20 rounded-sm h-12

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise overlay (opacity 0.03) on solid backgrounds to prevent digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px borders with low opacity (white/10) to define structure without clutter.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Avoid soft diffuse shadows. Use sharp, directional shadows or glow effects for active states.

motion.hover: Slight scale (1.02) and brightness boost on interactive cards.

instructions_to_main_agent.general: You are building a high-octane fitness brand, not a corporate SaaS. Be bold. Be aggressive. Use the 'Tetris' grid for the landing page to break monotony.
instructions_to_main_agent.theme_setup: Ensure 'dark' class is applied to the root/html element by default. The site should be dark mode only.
instructions_to_main_agent.components: Use Shadcn for the 'Admin Dashboard' (Attendance, Forms) but heavily customize the colors to match the Zinc-950/Red-600 palette. For the 'Landing Page', build custom layouts using Tailwind classes directly to achieve the 'Anti-AI' look.
instructions_to_main_agent.navigation: Create a sticky glassmorphic header (bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md) with a red bottom border (border-b border-red-600/20).
instructions_to_main_agent.admin_dashboard: The attendance manager must be dense. Use a table component with small padding. Add 'Export to Excel' functionality using a library like 'xlsx'.
instructions_to_main_agent.map: Embed the Google Map for 'Pilkhuwa, Uttar Pradesh 245304' in the contact section. Use a grayscale filter on the map if possible to match the theme.

do_not: Do not use gradients for text unless it's a very subtle metallic sheen.
Do not use rounded-xl or rounded-2xl. Stick to rounded-sm or rounded-none for that 'tough' look.
Do not use default blue colors for links or buttons.
must_do: Add data-testid to all interactive elements.
Ensure all text has sufficient contrast (WCAG AA).
